description:
US retail gasoline and diesel prices, collected weekly from official and public sources only.

Created by Sai Satya Pavan Pandu Vanka, a data engineer based in Dallas, TX. M.S. in Computer Information & Science, University of North Texas; AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate (2025). GitHub: github.com/saivanka | Hugging Face: huggingface.co/saisatyapavanpanduvanka | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/ssvanka

Sources, in order of authority:
1. U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update (https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/gasdiesel/) - the primary source. Weekly national and PADD regional prices.
2. AAA Gas Prices (https://gasprices.aaa.com/) - cross-check only. Daily national average and state averages.

What each weekly file contains (one file per week, named by the EIA reading date):
- National weekly regular gasoline (EIA) and national weekly diesel (EIA)
- Regional weekly regular gasoline (EIA) for 9 regions: East Coast (PADD 1), New England (1A), Central Atlantic (1B), Lower Atlantic (1C), Midwest (PADD 2), Gulf Coast (PADD 3), Rocky Mountain (PADD 4), West Coast (PADD 5), West Coast less California
- National daily regular gasoline (AAA) and up to 10 state regular averages (AAA)

Columns (fixed, 11): reading_date, source, area, area_type, fuel_type, price_usd_per_gal, change_vs_prior_week_usd, change_vs_year_ago_usd, source_url, captured_at_utc, notes. Change columns are EIA only. One unique row per (reading_date, source, area, fuel_type).

Accuracy rules - accuracy and traceability matter more than coverage: numbers are copied exactly as published (EIA: 3 decimals, AAA: 4 decimals); reading_date is the date the source gives, not the collection date; a value the source does not publish is left blank with an explanation in notes. Nothing is estimated, interpolated, invented, or filled from the other source. Every row records the exact page URL it was read from.

Latest file at first publication: 2026-10-19.csv - 22 rows, 0 blank prices. EIA reading date 2026-10-19 (US regular 4.284, US diesel 6.276, plus 9 regions); AAA reading date 2026-10-23 (US regular 4.2926, plus 10 states).

Updates: a new file is added every week and published automatically from the source repository, github.com/saivanka/gas-prices-weekly, via GitHub Actions, after validation. That repository also holds the full README, data dictionary, and methodology.

Attribution and licence: EIA data is produced by a U.S. government agency and is in the public domain. AAA averages are republished here with attribution to AAA Gas Prices for research purposes; check AAA's terms before any commercial reuse. The licence is therefore shown as Unknown, rather than claiming a single licence over both sources.
subtitle: Weekly EIA and AAA gasoline and diesel prices - no estimated values
title: US Retail Gasoline and Diesel Prices - Weekly
